summary: The filing reports entry into an amended management agreement and an amended LLC agreement establishing new share classes with varying fee structures. No acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, activist campaign, strategic review, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC transaction, or forced management change is present. The changes are routine corporate governance and fee adjustments for a non-traded infrastructure company. This is an ordinary current report of a contractual amendment and share class creation, not a special situation.
